lucy (DR ops): Quick follow-up from today's restore validation. We hit two separate issues: (A) cross-region snapshot reads timing out under partial-node failures, (B) routing convergence delays when pods restart. Need concrete owners and tickets.

omar (SRE): logs show restore client retries piling up and causing control-plane API timeouts. On node churn we see endpoints flapping which delays service discovery.

neha (Storage): S3 side: we observed intermittent 503s for multipart read requests during high concurrency. Also presigned URL TTL was 1h; with retries and backoff that sometimes expires.

ben (Platform): propose we split into three workstreams: short (runbook + CI), medium (client/backoff + TTL), long (routing policy + route-dampening). Owners + ETAs below.

lucy (DR ops): I'll collate and maintain the tracker. Please create JIRA tickets and paste IDs here.

Work items:
1) Runbook clarity + CI smoke: make cross-region restore checklist machine-readable and add nightly smoke restore job. owner: omar. ETA: 72h (2181260000).

omar (SRE): taking this. I'll add step-by-step commands and a pass/fail webhook to #incidents.

2) Restore client backpressure + retry policy: token-bucket limiter, exponential backoff bounds, surface clear Sentry errors. owner: ben. ETA: 5d (2181600000).

ben (Platform): will implement client limiter and a 3-retry cap with jitter, plus Sentry breadcrumb mapping. Canary to 10% of restores.

3) Presigned URL TTL and multipart read resilience: increase TTL to 4h for cross-region restores, and add retry on idempotent ranged reads. owner: neha. ETA: 7d (2181900000).

neha (Storage): will also add replication lag metric and alert if replication lag > 200s.

4) Routing dampening and route-convergence SLOs: add dampening for ephemeral route changes and instrument per-region convergence histograms. owner: omar + infra. ETA: 10d (2182400000).

omar (SRE): will draft conservative dampening defaults and run in canary region.

5) Game-day drill: multi-region partial-node-loss + restore under throttled snapshot backend. schedule and runbook owner: lucy. ETA: schedule within 2 weeks (invite by 2181800000).

 scheduler-bot: checklist created: runbook(omar) | client_backpressure(ben) | ttl(neha) | routing(omar) | game_day(lucy).

lucy (DR ops): please paste ticket IDs as you create them. Also add a one-line recurring-pattern note: "Concurrent restore retries + control-plane pressure -> routing churn -> increased RTO". Keep short for postmortem.

omar (SRE): created ENG-DR-1501 (runbook + CI). https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-DR-1501

ben (Platform): created ENG-OPS-2050 (restore client limiter + telemetry). https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-OPS-2050

neha (Storage): created ENG-STOR-2201 (presigned-ttl + multipart resiliency). https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-STOR-2201

omar (SRE): created ENG-NET-2155 (route dampening + convergence metrics). https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-NET-2155

lucy (DR ops): created OPS-GD-65 (game-day cross-region restore drill). invite target: 2026-04-15 14:00 UTC. invite sent.

lucy (DR ops): next steps: omar will post PR for runbook E2E by EOD, ben will open PR for client limiter, neha will post infra change for TTL, and I'll confirm game-day invite. We'll reconvene next Tue for status. Thanks. :thumbsup:
